name: Tidal
description:
𝐖𝐞𝐥𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐓𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐥 - 𝐓𝐡𝐞 #𝟏 𝐬𝐩𝐨𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐏𝐯𝐏

“𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐓𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐥..?”

Tidal is a fresh and upcoming Minecraft: Bedrock Edition PvP practice server, designed to deliver a unique, competitive, and thrilling experience for players of all skill levels.

“𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐓𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐥?”

Let’s face it PvP today just doesn’t hit the same. Whether it’s due to gameplay changes or version updates, that classic PvP spark feels lost.

Tidal’s mission is to reignite that excitement and bring back the golden age of PvP. Here's how:

∎ 𝐌𝐮𝐥𝐭𝐢-𝐕𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐒𝐮𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭

PvP on newer Minecraft versions (post-1.18.12) has become a challenge due to input delay, strange mechanics, and countless bugs.

𝙏𝙞𝙙𝙖𝙡 𝙨𝙤𝙡𝙫𝙚𝙨 𝙩𝙝𝙞𝙨!

With multi-version support, you can play on smooth, stable legacy versions that feel just right, free from the frustrations of recent updates.

∎ 𝐂𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐦 𝐀𝐧𝐭𝐢-𝐂𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐭

The PvP scene is plagued with cheaters, and we’re not standing for it.

Tidal features a custom Anti-Cheat system with 20 detection types, regularly updated to ensure a clean and fair competitive environment.

∎ 𝐏𝐯𝐏, 𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐖𝐚𝐲

Whether you’re looking to warm up with advanced PvP bots, jump into fast-paced FFA battles, or test your skills in intense ranked and unranked 1v1 duels, Tidal offers a wide range of game modes for every type of player.

Join us today and experience PvP the way it was meant to be.
